title: CDIF Data Structure profile
description: Marked by an explicit data-structure description: a cdi:isStructuredBy link to a DataStructure node, or a node typed as one of the DDI-CDI structure classes. cdi: and not cdif:, because the property takes a canonical DDI-CDI structure. cdi:DataStructure is listed alongside the three specialisations: it is one of the profile's four variants and was missing, so a record using the base class went undetected. The validity gate is the cdifDataStructureComponent content shapes.
